If interested, readers can search the relevant resources online on their own.

p174.original: 奇怪的是，与英雄和英雄主义有关的系统研究相对较少，尤其是与本章所揭示的关于人性黑暗面的大量研究相比。即使在宾夕法尼亚大学（University of Pennsylvania）的马丁·塞利格曼（Martin Seligman）发起的积极心理学运动中，这些术语也不在其词汇中。同情心、同理心和道德勇气作为“个人的优点和美德”被包括在内，而英雄主义则作为一种行动被排除在外。但是只有发挥这些内在美德，我们才能改变人们的生活，并最终改变世界。本书作者创建了一个名为“英雄想象项目”的非营利基金会，该基金会使用基本的心理思想教人们如何在训练中成为英雄：当生活向你发起了挑战时，你该如何采取行动去反抗它。
p174.en: Curiously, there is relatively little systematic research related to heroes and heroism, especially when compared to the vast amount of research on the dark side of humanity revealed in this chapter. These terms are not included in the glossary, even in the active psychological campaign launched by Martin Seligman of the University of Pennsylvania. Compassion, common sense and moral courage are included as “personal virtues and virtues”, while heroism is excluded as an act. But it is only through the exercise of these inner virtues that we can change people's lives and ultimately the world. The author of this book created a non-profit foundation called the Heroes Imagination Project, which uses basic psychology to teach people how to become heroes in training: how to act against life when it challenges you.

p175.original: 11.4 米尔格拉姆研究的跨文化测试
p175.en: 11.4 Cross-Cultural Testing of the Millgram Study

p177.original: 利用米尔格拉姆的研究结果启发人们做出富有同情心的行为。
p177.en: The results of the Mirgram study were used to inspire compassionate behaviour.

p178.original: 由于结构化的设计和详细的报告，许多国家的独立研究人员对米尔格拉姆基本的服从实验进行了复制，这些研究结果可以对人们的同情行为产生影响。最近有人对在美国进行的8项研究和在欧、非、亚国家进行的9项重复研究的服从率进行了比较。在不同国家的不同研究中发现高水平服从率普遍存在。在美国的重复研究中平均服从率为61%，与在其他国家样本中的66%的服从率相似。在美国的研究中，服从率为31%～91%，在跨国家的重复研究中，服从率最低为澳大利亚的28%，最高为南非的88%。服从率具有跨时间、地点的稳定性。研究的年份（1963—1985年）与服从的程度之间没有什么关联（Blass，2004）。
p178.en: As a result of structured design and detailed reports, independent researchers in many countries replicated the basic subjectivity experiment of Mirgram, the results of which can have an impact on people's sympathetic behaviour. A comparison of the compliance rates of the eight studies conducted in the United States and the nine duplicate studies carried out in the European, African and Asian countries has recently been made. High levels of submission were found to be prevalent in different studies in different countries. In the United States, the average compliance rate was 61 per cent, similar to 66 per cent in the sample of other countries. In United States studies, the compliance rate ranged from 31 to 91 per cent, and in cross-country duplicate studies, the compliance rate was lowest in Australia at 28 per cent and highest in South Africa at 88 per cent. The compliance rate is stable across time and place. There is little correlation between the year of study (1963-1985) and the degree of obedience (Blass, 2004).

p179.original: 11.4.1 米尔格拉姆的服从权威是否仍然适用
p179.en: 11.4.1 Whether or not Milgram's obligating authority remains applicable

p180.original: 荷兰的乌得勒支大学（Utrecht University）和西西里岛的巴勒莫大学（Palermo University）的研究人员使用米尔格拉姆实验的变式，用言语批评代替了“电击”，他们的服从率与米尔格拉姆的某些研究相类似。他们创造的情境是，在表演者表现不佳时，一位教练为了增强表演者的心理韧性，会提供越来越严厉的口头反馈。给予表演者的口头反馈包括针对他的表演的一系列渐进式负面评论以及描述他缺乏能力的粗鲁言辞。例如，温和的负面批评是“你的表现变差了”，中等的负面反馈是“你真的很荒谬”，最极端的负面反馈是“你真的是我见过的最愚蠢的人”。通过观察教练是否做出了15条批评性反馈判断其是否服从权威。在乌得勒支大学的研究中，扮演教练角色的学生中有90%以上做出了15条批评性反馈（Meeus & Raaijmakers，1986）。在使用相同实验程序的西西里岛的研究中，服从率仅为30%，但这是在教练和表演者非常接近且实验者在相邻房间的实验条件下的结果。这些发现与米尔格拉姆在相同实验变量中的实验结果相呼应（Bocchiaro & Zimbardo，2010）。
p180.en: Researchers at Utrecht University in the Netherlands and Palermo University in Sicily used the variant of the Millgram experiment to replace “electric shocks” with verbal criticism, and their compliance was similar to that of some of Millgram's studies. They create a situation where a coach, in order to increase the mental resilience of the performer, provides increasingly harsh oral feedback when the performer fails to perform. The oral feedback given to the performer included a series of progressive negative comments on his performance, as well as rude remarks describing his lack of capacity. For example, the moderate negative criticism is that “your performance has deteriorated”, the moderate negative feedback is that “you are really ridiculous”, and the most extreme negative feedback is that “you are really the dumbest person I have ever seen”. It is through observation of whether the coaches have given 15 critical feedbacks to determine whether or not they are subject to authority. In a study at the University of Utrecht, more than 90 per cent of the students who played the role of coaches provided 15 critical feedback (Meeus & Raaijmakers, 1986). In Sicily, where the same experimental procedure was used, the compliance rate was only 30 per cent, but this was the result of experiments in which the coaches and performers were very close and the experimenters were in the adjacent room. These findings echo the results of the experiment in the same experimental variable as Mirgram (Bocchiaro & Zimbardo, 2010).

p181.original: 研究员杰里·伯格（Jerry Burger，2009）与一个新闻网络机构合作重复了米尔格拉姆的研究，实验中的被试主要为加利福尼亚圣塔克拉拉大学（Santa Clara University in California）的大学生。出于伦理原因，当老师按下电压为150伏的开关（第十级）时，该研究便终止了（在米尔格拉姆看来，这是一个关键的决定点）。结果再一次显示大多数人都服从了实验的指示，而且40年过去了，伯格的发现与米尔格拉姆的发现几乎也没有区别。
p181.en: Jerry Burger, a researcher in collaboration with a news network, repeated the Milgram study, which was tested mainly by university students at Santa Clara University in California. For ethical reasons, the study ended when the teacher pressed the switch (class X) with a voltage of 150 volts (which, in the view of Mirgram, was a key decision point). The results show once again that the majority of the people were following the instructions of the experiment and that, 40 years later, the discovery of Berg was almost identical to that of Mirgram.

p182.original: 在此之后，2010年，法国的电视节目进行了米尔格拉姆实验，现场观众可以投票决定是否电击受害者。尽管该名男子痛苦地恳求他们停下来，但在充满魅力的主持人的怂恿下和现场观众喊出的“惩罚”呼声及令人振奋的音乐中，绝大多数参与者都服从了命令继续实施电击。在“死亡游戏”中，给予最大电击的百分比飙升至80%！
p182.en: This was followed by an experiment conducted in 2010 on French television programmes in Milgram, where viewers could vote whether to shock victims or not. Despite the man's painful plea to stop, the overwhelming majority of participants, at the instigation of the glamorous facilitator and in the “punishment” cry and exciting music of the audience, followed orders to continue to carry out electric shocks. In the Death Game, the percentage of maximum electroshocks skyrocketed to 80%!

p183.original: 11.4.2 我们为什么会服从权威

p184.original: 通过米尔格拉姆在其原始研究基础上进行的许多变式及最近的重复实验，我们推论出在以下情况下人们倾向于服从权威：
p184.en: Through the many variants and recent repetitious experiments carried out by Mirgram on the basis of its original research, we conclude that people tend to submit to authority in the following circumstances:

p185.original: 当同伴作为榜样服从权威人物的命令时；
p185.en: (a) When a fellow man obeys the orders of an authority as an example;

p186.original: 当受害者远离老师，无法被看到或听到，从而提高了匿名感和距离感时；
p186.en: (b) When the victim is far from the teacher and is unable to be seen or heard, thereby increasing the sense of anonymity and distance;

p187.original: 当老师受到权威人物的直接监视时；
p187.en: When the teacher is under direct surveillance by a person of authority;

p188.original: 当权威人物的地位高于老师时。
p188.en: When authority figures take precedence over teachers.

p189.original: 那么，我们从中可以学习到什么呢？如果仔细查看这些条件（见图11-4），你会发现服从效应是由情境变量而不是人格变量引起的。实际上，对被试进行的人格测验中没有发现任何服从者与反抗者有所区别的特征，也没有发现服从者的任何心理障碍或异常。这些发现使我们能够排除人格对服从行为的影响。将实验结果应用到现实世界中，我们还可以概述出诱使普通人甚至是好人服从权威的10个基本步骤或过程，如表11-3所示。
p189.en: So, what can we learn from it? If you look closely at these conditions (see figure 11-4), you will find that the compliance effect is caused by a situational rather than a personality variable. In fact, the test personality tests did not reveal any distinguishing features between the subject and the resistance, nor did they reveal any psychological disorder or abnormality of the subject. These findings make it possible to exclude the effects of personality on obedience. Applying the results of the experiment to the real world, we can also outline 10 basic steps or processes that induce ordinary people, even good people, to submit to authority, as shown in Table 11-3.

p190.original: 表11-3 走向邪恶的10个步骤——让好人伤害他人
p190.en: Table 11-3 Ten Steps Towards Evil - Letting Good People Harm

p191.original: 共同社会规范对服从权威的影响确实胜过人格的影响。但是，提醒自己遵守规则、法律法规和社会规范对于任何群体、社会和国家的运作都是至关重要的。这意味着个人行使选择权的自由必须以对群体最有利的方式来调节，这也是民主的基本含义之一。
p191.en: The influence of common social norms on the subordination of authority is indeed greater than that of personality. However, alerting oneself to rules, laws and social norms is essential for the functioning of any group, society and the State. This means that the freedom of individuals to exercise their right to choose must be regulated in the best interests of the group, which is also one of the basic meanings of democracy.

p192.original: 11.4.3 米尔格拉姆服从权威范式在现实世界的扩展
p192.en: 11.4.3 Milgram obeys the expansion of the authoritative paradigm in the real world

p193.original: 让我们看一下在两种现实环境中对权威的盲目服从：
p193.en: Let's look at the blind submission to authority in two realities:

p194.original: 1. 护士是否愿意遵循医生的危险命令的研究；
p194.en: 1. A study of the willingness of nurses to follow a doctor's hazard orders;

p195.original: 2. 一个商店管理人员遵循假冒警官的电话命令，侵犯了一名员工隐私的真实事件。
p195.en: 2. The fact that a store manager had followed a telephone order to impersonate a police officer violated the privacy of an employee.

p196.original: 护士遵守医生的危险命令 如果老师和学生之间的关系是基于权力的权威关系，那么医生和护士之间的服从比率又是多少呢？为了找出答案，研究人员对医生和护士进行了研究，通过确定护士在真实的医院环境中是否会服从一位不相识的医生的不正当请求，来测试该权威关系中的服从情况（Hofling et al.，1966）。22名护士分别接到一位不相识的医生打来的电话，并被告知她们在他到达医院之前给患者服用一种药物。他命令的服用剂量是最大剂量的双倍。当这个难题只是一个假想的情景时，该医院的12名护士中有10名表示拒绝服从，因为这违反了医院的程序（Krackow & Blass，1995）。但是，当这种难题在现实情景中出现时：在接受研究的22名护士中，有21名将药物（实际上是假药）给了患者，直到研究人员阻止她们这样做。那个唯一不服从的护士应该加薪并被授予英雄勋章！
p196.en: If the relationship between a teacher and a student is based on authority, what is the rate of compliance between a doctor and a nurse? In order to find answers, researchers have studied doctors and nurses to test compliance in this authoritative relationship by determining whether the nurse would be subject to the improper request of an unknown physician in a real hospital environment (Hofling et al. 1966). Twenty-two nurses received separate calls from an unknown doctor and were told that they had given the patient a medication before he arrived at the hospital. The dose he ordered was double the maximum dose. When this difficulty was only a hypothetical scenario, 10 of the 12 nurses at the hospital said they refused to obey because it violated hospital procedures (Krackow & Blass, 1995). However, when this problem arises in reality: 21 of the 22 nurses studied gave the drug (in fact, the counterfeit drug) to the patient until the researcher prevented them from doing so. The only insubordination nurse should be paid a raise and be awarded the Heroes Medal!

p197.original: 快餐店的权威恶作剧 米尔格拉姆效应在现实世界中的另一个惊世例证是来自美国32个州的68家快餐店的电话骗局。快餐店的店长助理盲目服从了一个假冒警官在电话中的命令，对一名年轻女性员工进行搜身检查，因为该员工身藏赃物。
p197.en: Another dramatic example of the real world of the Milgram effect is the phone scam of 68 fast food restaurants in 32 states of the United States. The assistant director of the fast-food restaurant blindly obeyed a false police officer's orders on the telephone and searched a young female employee for possession of stolen property.

p198.original: 之后假警官指示店长助理将员工扣留在快餐店后面的房屋内，将她的衣服脱光，然后进行彻底搜查，寻找失窃的货物。来电者坚持要店长助理详细地描述现场情况，而监控录像也一直在记录这些令人震惊的事件的进展。在肯塔基州（Kentucky）的麦当劳，虐待行为升级为店长助理要对女员工进行性侵犯（Wolfson，2005）。这些过程全部被摄像头记录下来，其中一些可以在网上搜索到和浏览（但没有性侵犯场面）。
p198.en: The fake police officer then instructed the assistant shopkeeper to keep her staff behind the house at the fast-food restaurant, strip her clothes off, and then conduct a thorough search to find the stolen goods. The caller insisted that the assistant shopkeeper give a detailed description of the situation on the ground, and surveillance videos have been documenting the progress of these alarming events. In McDonald's, Kentucky, abuse escalated to sexual assault of female employees by assistant shopkeepers (Wolfson, 2005). All of these processes are recorded on camera and some of them can be searched and browsed online (no scene of sexual assault).

p199.original: 这种怪异的不在场权威不但诱使数十名普通员工违反快餐店的政策，也违背了他们自己的道德和道德原则，骚扰和侮辱诚实的年轻员工。2007年，假冒警官的人被发现了，他曾经是一名狱警，但因缺乏直接证据而获释。其中一名受害者是一个19岁女孩，她遭到性虐待，之后店长助理给她一大笔补偿金。在2012年圣丹斯电影节上首映的克雷格·佐贝（Craig Zobel）执导的引人入胜的电影《服从》（Compliance），描述了许多年轻无辜妇女陷入这种权威骗局，并遭受性虐待的噩梦。读者可以自行在网上搜索关于这一令人恐慌的事件的更多信息。
p199.en: This strange authority of being absent not only induces dozens of ordinary employees to violate the fast-food policies, but also to harass and insult honest young employees against their own moral and moral principles. In 2007, the impersonator of the police officer, who had been a prison guard, was found, but was released for lack of direct evidence. One of the victims was a 19-year-old girl who was sexually abused and was subsequently given a substantial compensation by the assistant to the shopkeeper. The fascinating film Compliance, spearheaded by Craig Zobel, at the 2012 St. Dans Film Festival, describes the many young and innocent women caught up in such an authoritative scheme and subjected to a nightmare of sexual abuse. Readers can search online for more information about this alarming event.

p200.original: 你可能认为这种恶作剧的原因与员工和店长助理的天真无知、容易受骗的性格有关。但是，当我们得知此骗局已在美国的许多州、许多不同的快餐店都成功实施，并且数十名店长助理受到欺骗时，那么我们的分析就必须从简单地批评受害者转变为承认在这种情境下权威的力量。此外，几十年来的社会心理学研究证实了这一点。遗憾的是，这些研究也显示了同样的效果。店长助理之一唐娜·萨默（Donna Summer）警告记者，不要急于判断，因为除非他们也遇到同样的情况，否则他们也无法预测自己可能会做些什么（Gibney，2006）。在阅读了本章并了解到人类判断中的基本归因错误后，我们也会提供给你更加确切的建议。
p200.en: You may think that the reason for this prank is related to the naiveness and vulnerability of employees and shop assistants. But when we learn that the scam has been successfully carried out in many states in the United States, in many different fast-food restaurants, and dozens of assistant shopkeepers have been deceived, our analysis must move from simply criticizing the victims to recognizing the power of authority in such situations. Moreover, decades of psychosocial research have confirmed this. Unfortunately, these studies have shown the same results. Donna Summer, one of the assistant shopkeepers, warned journalists not to rush judgement, because they could not predict what they might do unless they were in the same situation (Gibney, 2006). We will also provide you with more precise advice after reading this chapter and learning of the fundamental attribution error in human judgement.

p201.original: 11.5 旁观者问题：不作为的罪恶
p201.en: 11.5 The Bystander Problem: The Sin of Inaction

p204.original: 埃塞俄比亚（Ethiopia）前皇帝海尔·塞拉西（Haile Selassie）曾言：“在历史的长河中，存在着许多使得邪恶的势力逐渐扩张的人：他们本应行动却选择旁观、本应施以援手却保持冷漠、在正义缺失时却保持沉默。”
p204.en: The former Ethiopian Emperor Haile Selassie once said: “There are many people in the river of history who have gradually expanded evil forces: they should have acted but chose to be bystanders, they should have helped but remained indifferent, and they remain silent when justice is lacking.

p205.original: 伤害并不总是来自伤害性行为。当有人需要帮助时，他人的不作为也会造成伤害。这一事实可以使用震惊全美、体现人性冷漠的经典事件来说明。1964年3月13日，《纽约时报》报道了一个悲剧，一名男子持刀在皇后区附近袭击并杀害了基蒂·珍诺维斯（Kitty Genovese），而她的38位邻居目睹了她在一个半小时内被三次袭击。报道中还称旁观者的声音和他们卧室突然的亮灯使行凶者暂停了两次袭击，但每次他都会返回并再次行凶。根据该报道，在该妇女被谋杀后，只有一名目击者报警。
p205.en: Harm does not always come from harmful behaviour. When someone needs help, the inaction of others can also cause harm. This fact can be illustrated by classic events that shock the whole of America and reflect human apathy. On 13 March 1964, The New York Times reported a tragedy in which a man with a knife attacked and killed Kitty Genovese in the vicinity of Queens, while 38 of her neighbours witnessed her being attacked three times in an hour and a half. It was also reported that the sound of the bystanders and the sudden lights in their bedrooms had caused the perpetrators to suspend two attacks, but that he returned and again attacked each time. According to the report, only one witness reported the murder of the woman to the police.

p206.original: 基蒂·珍诺维斯被谋杀的故事成了热点新闻。它震惊了全美，媒体也对旁观者和纽约人的冷漠进行了评价。他们为什么没有伸出援手？它只发生在纽约吗？还是可能在任何地方都会发生同样的事情？
p206.en: The story of the murder of Kitty Genoves has become news. It shocked the United States and the media assessed the apathy of bystanders and New Yorkers. Why didn't they help us? Is it only happening in New York? Or is it possible that the same thing will happen anywhere?

p207.original: 基蒂·珍诺维斯，1964年在纽约市遭到残酷暴行和旁观者冷漠的对待。
p207.en: Kitty Genoves, who was subjected to brutal acts and bystanders in New York City in 1964.

p208.original: 最近对警察记录和其他档案材料的调查发现，真实情况与《纽约时报》的原始报道不同（Manning et al.，2007）。首先，38人目睹了这一事件是没有根据的。其次，大多数袭击发生在玄关处，邻居无法注意到。而且，在袭击发生过程中警察确实接到了几个报警电话。我们还要记住，那时没有911这种方便拨打的紧急电话号码。当然，这仍然是一场悲剧，但是没有事实证明纽约人是原报道中那种冷漠的旁观者。从心理学上来说，这次基蒂·珍诺维斯事件的重要结果是，它引发了对旁观者干预的一些重要研究，这些研究着眼于情境的力量。在什么情境下，人们会提供帮助呢？
p208.en: A recent investigation of police records and other archival material found that the real situation was different from the original report in The New York Times (Manning et al., 2007). First, 38 people witnessed the incident without any basis. Secondly, most of the attacks occurred at the frontal gate, which the neighbours could not notice. Moreover, police did receive several telephone calls during the attack. We should also remember that there were no easy emergency numbers at that time. Of course, it remains a tragedy, but there is no proof that New Yorkers are the kind of apathy that was reported. Psychologically, the important result of the Kitty Genoves incident was that it triggered some important research into the intervention of bystanders, which was situational in nature. In what circumstances would people help?

p209.original: 不幸的是，公众对遇难者的不作为和冷漠态度是一个不受时间或地域限制的普遍问题。2009年10月，在加利福尼亚州里士满（Richmond，California）高中的一次舞蹈课之后，在短短2小时内一名15岁的女学生被至少5个男生残忍地轮奸并殴打。而十多个人选择了袖手旁观，没有人拨打911紧急电话，甚至有人在发短信“报道”整个事件。2015年，在佛罗里达州的巴拿马城（Panama City，Florida），一名女性在光天化日之下被轮奸，一群人选择了围观，甚至有人用手机拍摄视频。这种情况在世界范围内经常发生，但它应该变少。
p209.en: Unfortunately, public inaction and indifference towards the victims is a general problem that is not limited by time or geography. In October 2009, after a dance class at Richmond, California High School, a 15-year-old female student was brutally gang-raped and beaten by at least five boys in just two hours. More than a dozen people chose to stand idly by and no one called the 911 emergency and even texted “report” the whole incident. In 2015, in Panama City, Florida, a woman was gang-raped in broad daylight and a group of people chose to watch and even filmed on her mobile phone. This is a situation that often occurs around the world, but it should be reduced.

p211.original: 基蒂·珍诺维斯的谋杀案引起了两位年轻的社会心理学家比布·拉塔内（Bibb Latané）和约翰·达利（John Darley）的关注，他们开始了一系列有关旁观者干预问题（bystander intervention problem）的研究。这些研究对真实紧急情况下旁观者所面临的困境进行了巧妙的模拟。在其中的一个实验中，实验者让一名大学生独自待在一个带有对讲机的房间里，并告诉他相邻房间里的一名或多名学生正在与他交流。在他们讨论个人问题时，此人好像听到了另一名学生癫痫发作并喘着气寻求帮助的声音。在此期间，旁观者无法与其他学生交流，无法获得他们是否在做应急处理的信息。
p211.en: The murder of Kitty Genoves attracted the attention of two young social psychologists, Bibb Latané and John Darley, who began a series of studies on the intervention of bystanders. These studies provide a clever simulation of the plight of bystanders in real emergencies. In one of these experiments, the experimenter left a university student alone in a room with a walkie-talkie and told him that one or more students in the adjacent room were communicating with him. When they discussed individual issues, it appeared that the person heard another student with epilepsy and breathing in search of help. During this period, bystanders were unable to communicate with other students and to obtain information as to whether they were in emergency situations.

p212.original: 旁观者会报告紧急情况吗？如果会，他所认为的与他一起讨论的人数是否会影响他的行动速度？你怎么认为？
p212.en: Will the bystanders report an emergency? If so, would the number of persons he believed to be discussing with him affect his pace of action? What do you think?

p213.original: 事实证明，旁观者的行动速度确实取决于他认为在场的其他旁观者的数量。当他们认为相邻房间的人越多，他们报告癫痫发作的速度就越慢。人格测验显示被试的特定人格特征与他们的干预可能性和速度之间没有显著关系，而是与情境有关。如图11-5所示，所有处于双人组的被试都在不到3分钟的时间内进行了干预，而处于人数较多的组的被试只有60%的人通知实验者可能发生的紧急情况（Latané & Darley，1968）。
p213.en: It has proved that the speed of action of the bystanders does depend on the number of other bystanders that he believes are present. The more people they think are in the adjacent rooms, the slower they report epilepsy. The personality test shows that there is no significant relationship between the specific personality characteristics tested and their likelihood of intervention and speed, but rather a situational relationship. As shown in figure 11-5, all trials in the double group were intervened in less than three minutes, while only 60 per cent of those in the larger group were able to notify the experimenter of the possible emergency (Latané & Darley, 1968).

p214.original: 实验者解释道：干预的可能性随着小组人数的增加而降低是因为，每个人都认为他人会提供帮助，因此他们不必进行干预。将自己视为一大群潜在干预者中的一员的个体会经历责任分散（diffusion of responsibility）：每个小组成员伸以援手的责任都会被削弱。如果你在车来车往的高速公路上开车时看到一辆汽车发生了故障，你可能会体验到责任分散，因为你相信肯定会有其他人停下来并提供帮助，而后径自离去。
p214.en: The experimenters explained that the likelihood of intervention decreased as the number of teams increased because everyone thought that others would help, so they did not have to intervene. Individuals who see themselves as part of a large group of potential interveners experience a decentralization of responsibility: the responsibility of each member of the team to reach out to help is diminished. If you see a car malfunction while driving on the motorway, you may experience a fragmentation of responsibility, because you believe that someone else will stop and help and leave.

p215.original: 图11-5 旁观者在不同群体大小条件下对紧急情况的干预行为
p215.en: Figure 11-5: Interventions by bystanders in emergencies in different group sizes

p216.original: 注：紧急情况中出现的人越多，旁观者干预的可能性就越小。正如这项研究结果的摘要所表明的，旁观者在小群体（两个人）中行动最快。
p216.en: Note: The more people emerge in emergencies, the less likely the bystanders will be to intervene. As the summary of the results of the study shows, bystanders are the fastest among small groups (two persons).

p217.original: 另一个因素无疑也在起作用，即从众。正如你从核心概念和阿希的从众研究中了解到的，当人们不知道该怎么做时，他们会从他人那里获取线索。旁观者研究中也是如此，那些没有干预的人观察他人的行为并模仿他人的不作为。他们通过他人的袖手旁观来定义该情境下的规范就是保持冷漠，即“什么都不做，不要卷入其中”。但是，只要有一个人干预以提供帮助，其他人就会在几秒钟之内共同帮助他人。新规范：做点什么、帮助、采取行动。我们给你的建议：成为那个人——享受独一无二的力量！
p217.en: Another factor is undoubtedly also working, namely, public opinion. As you know from the core concept and from Ash's public research, when people don't know what to do, they get clues from others. The same is true for bystanders, who do not intervene to observe the behaviour of others and imitate their inaction. They define the norm in this situation through the inaction of others by maintaining indifference, which means “do nothing and do not get involved”. But as long as one intervenes to help, others will come together to help others in a few seconds. New norms: do something, help, take action. We give you advice: to be that man -- to enjoy the power of one!

p218.original: 11.5.2 训练是否能促进助人行为

p219.original: 有两项研究表明，我们可以通过适当的训练来解决旁观者问题。泰德·休斯顿和他的同事（Ted Huston et al.，1981）发现，在真实的紧急情况下助人者与非助人者的人格特征并没有什么区别。但是他们确实发现，在处理紧急情况时，助人者更多地接受过有关医疗、警务、急救或心肺复苏的训练，这些训练可以帮助他们应对紧急情况。另一项研究表明，关于旁观者问题的心理学讲座也能促进助人行为（Beaman et al.，1978）。学生和实验者的同谋在门前碰到一个“求助者”，但实验者的同谋却无动于衷。那些参加过旁观者干预课程的人尝试提供帮助的可能性是未参加者的两倍。最近，针对学校中的霸凌和性侵犯事件的旁观者的教育干预已成功地增加了参与者的助人意图和行为（Pfetsch et al.，2011；Katz & Moore，2013）。教育功不可没，我们希望你也能运用本章的内容有所建树。
p219.en: Two studies have shown that we can solve the bystanders problem through appropriate training. Ted Houston and his colleagues (Ted Huston et al., 1981) found that there was no difference between the personality characteristics of the person assisting the person in a real emergency and the person not helping the person. They do, however, find that, in dealing with emergencies, helpers are more trained in medical, police, first aid or CPR, which can help them to respond to emergencies. Another study has shown that psychological lectures on bystanders also promote assistive behaviour (Beaman et al., 1978). The co-conspirator of the student and the experiment met a “helper” in front of the door, but the co-conspirator did not do anything. Those who have attended bystanders intervention courses are twice as likely to try to help as those who have not participated. Recently, educational interventions targeting bystanders of bullying and sexual assault in schools have been successful in increasing the motivation and behaviour of participants (Pfetsch et al., 2011); Katz & Moore, 2013. Educational excellence is essential, and we hope that you can use the contents of this chapter to make a difference.

p220.original: 11.5.3 需要帮助吗？直接求助吧
p220.en: 11.5.3 Can I help you? Just ask for help.

p221.original: 为了证明情境力量具有积极作用，社会心理学家汤姆·莫里亚蒂（Tom Moriarity，1975）进行了两个有趣的实验。
p221.en: In order to prove the positive impact of the situation, the social psychologist Tom Moriarty, 1975, conducted two interesting experiments.

p222.original: 1. 在第一项研究中，纽约人在餐馆里看到一个小偷在一位女士离开桌子时，偷走了她的手提箱。
p222.en: In the first study, New Yorkers saw a thief steal her suitcase while a woman was leaving the table.

p223.original: 2. 在第二项研究中，他们看到一个小偷趁物主离开的时候偷走了沙滩毯子上的一台便携式收音机。
p223.en: 2. In the second study, they saw a thief steal a portable radio on the beach blanket while the owner was leaving.

p224.original: 那么这些旁观者会做什么呢？有些人什么也没做，让小偷得逞。但是有些人进行了干预。什么情境会影响人们的助人行为呢？在每个实验中，被盗者（实验者的同谋）会向即将看到偷盗行为的观察者询问“你有时间吗”或“我离开后，可以请你照看我的书包（收音机）吗”。第一种互动中并不会引起个人责任感，盗窃产生后，几乎所有旁观者都袖手旁观。但是，那些同意帮助照看受害者财产的旁观者，几乎都进行了干预。他们喊人帮忙，甚至有人在海滩上拦截小偷！
p224.en: So what are these bystanders gonna do? Some people did nothing to make the thief succeed. But some people intervened. What circumstances affect people's actions in support of others? In each case, the stolen person (the accomplice of the experiment) asks the soon-to-be-seen observer “Do you have time” or “Can I ask you to look after my school bag (radio) when I leave?” The first interaction did not lead to a sense of personal responsibility, and almost all bystanders stood idly by after the theft. However, almost all the bystanders who agreed to help look after the property of the victims intervened. They called for help and even people stopped thieves on the beach!

p225.original: 令人欣喜的是，我们常常可以通过主动求助将冷眼旁观转变为个人行动，将无动于衷转变为热心肠。仅仅要求别人帮忙的举动就形成了人与人之间特殊的纽带，使情境发生了实质性的改变。在你与他人共享的社交世界中，求助行为引发了他人的责任感和助人行为。在这种情况下，普通百姓可以变得乐于助人。但是，在下文的专栏中，我们将会了解到特殊的情境可以使那些布道的神学学生由好撒玛利亚人转变为坏人。
p225.en: It is gratifying that we can often turn our eyes and eyes into personal action and our indifference into a warm heart by offering our own help. Actions that merely call for help create a special bond between people and make a substantial difference. In the social world that you share with others, the act of recourse triggers the sense of responsibility and the act of help. In such cases, ordinary people can become happy to help. But in the column below, we will learn about the special circumstances that can transform the theological students of the preaching profession from good Samaritans to bad people.

p226.original: 通过研究可知，增加从潜在帮助者那里获得帮助的机会的可能性有以下几种方式（Schroeder & Prentice，1995）。
p226.en: It is clear from research that the possibilities for increasing access to help from potential helpers are in the following ways (Schroeder & Prentice, 1995).

p227.original: 寻求帮助。让其他人知道你需要帮助，而不是自认为其他人能够意识到你的需要。
p227.en: Seek help. Let others know that you need help, not think that others are aware of your needs.

p228.original: 降低情景的模糊性。通过清楚地说明问题和应该采取的措施来减少情境的歧义，例如，“她晕倒了！马上叫救护车！”或“有人闯入我的房子，请报警并告诉警察我家的地址。”
p228.en: Reduce the ambiguity of scenarios. To reduce the ambiguity of the situation by clearly describing the problem and the measures to be taken, for example, “She fainted! Call an ambulance now! Or “Someone broke into my house, please call the police and give the police the address of my home.”

p229.original: 指定某个人。以免他们与在场其他人分散责任，例如，“穿着红色衬衫的朋友，请拨打911！”或“开蓝色丰田车的朋友可以帮忙叫两辆拖车吗？”
p229.en: Specify someone. So they don't get separated from the rest of the group, for example, "Friends in red shirts, call 911! Or, "Can a friend in a blue Toyota get two trailers?

p230.original: 当然，这些策略并不能百分之百保证你的人身或财产安全。但是，如果你独自一人面临紧急情况时，这些策略可能增加你获取帮助的希望。
p230.en: Of course, these tactics do not guarantee the safety of your person or your property 100 per cent. But if you are alone in an emergency, these strategies may increase your chances of getting help.

p231.original: 试一试 是什么使撒玛利亚人由好变坏
p231.en: Try it. What makes Samaritan bad?

p232.original: 既然你对旁观者干预已经有所了解，让我们来看看你是否可以从《圣经》中撒玛利亚人的故事中汲取灵感，并找到旁观者情境的关键变量。在所记载的故事中，几个重要人物由于太忙了而帮不了一个遇险的陌生人。最终身为局外人的撒玛利亚人抽出时间帮助了他。
p232.en: Now that you know something about bystanders, let's see if you can draw inspiration from the story of Samaritan in the Bible and find key variables in the bystanders' situation. In the stories documented, several important figures were not able to help a stranger in distress because they were too busy. The Samaritan, who was an outsider in the end, took the time to help him.

p233.original: • 遇险者的同胞未伸出援手是由于性格缺陷或人格造成的吗？
p233.en: • Are the lack of help from the fellow citizens of the persons in distress due to a character defect or personality?

p234.en: • Or is it a situational decision?

p235.original: 社会心理学家决定让普林斯顿神学院（Princeton Theological Seminary）的学生处于类似的情境中。更为讽刺的是，学生们认为评估他们好坏的根据是关于好撒玛利亚人寓言的布道质量。让我们看看当这些神学院学生遇到遇险者时会做什么。
p235.en: Social psychologists decided to put students at Princeton Theologue in a similar situation. Even more ironically, students believe that the basis for assessing their good and bad is the quality of the preaching of the good Samaritan. Let's see what these seminary students do when they're in distress.

p236.original: 手里拿着布道稿的学生们被带到附近要记录布道的建筑物旁。当学生走到两座建筑物之间的一条小巷时，他们遇到了一个在门口摔倒的男人，显然这个男人需要帮助。现在，学生们有机会实践他们将要布道的内容了。你猜哪个关键变量可以预测学生的助人行为？选择以下中的一项：
p236.en: Students with sermons were taken to nearby buildings to record the sermons. When the students went to an alley between the two buildings, they met a man who fell at the door, apparently in need of help. Now, students have an opportunity to practice what they're about to preach. And guess which key variable predicts the behavior of students? Select one of the following:

p237.original: • 学生的宗教信仰（由其同学评估）；
p237.en: • Religious beliefs of students (assessed by their peers);

p238.original: • 学生的神经质状况如何（根据大五人格进行评定）；
p238.en: • What is the neurostatus of the student (based on a five-person assessment);

p239.en: • The degree of hastyness of students;

p241.original: 通过随机将被试分配到三种不同的条件下来控制神学院学生的人格变量。因此，人格不是决定因素。相反，决定因素是一个情境变量：时间。在神学院的学生前往附近的建筑物中记录他们的布道之前，每个人都被告知必须花费多长时间到达录音室。有些人被分配到迟到组中，在这种情况下，他们必须匆忙赶去录音室。有的学生则被分配在准时组中，他们可以准时进行录音；第三组是早到组，他们在布道前有几分钟的空闲时间。
p241.en: The personality variable of the seminary students is controlled by randomly assigned to three different conditions. Personality is therefore not a determining factor. Rather, the determining factor is a situational variable: time. Before the students of the seminary went to a nearby building to record their sermons, everyone was told how long it would take to reach the studio. Some were assigned late to the group, in which case they had to rush to the studio. Some students are assigned to the punctual group, where they can make sound recordings on time; The third group arrived early and they had a few minutes of free time before the sermon.

p242.original: 结果如何？在迟到组中，只有10%的人提供了帮助。90%的人没有当好撒玛利亚人！在准时组中，有45%的人帮助了陌生人。早到组中的助人行为最多，有63%（见图11-6）。
p242.en: How'd it go? Only 10 per cent of the late-attendees provided assistance. 90% of the people are not Samaritan! Forty-five per cent of the punctual group helped strangers. Early attendance at the group was the highest, at 63 per cent (see figure 11-6).

p243.original: 值得注意的是，对于时间紧迫性的控制使处于迟到组的人提供帮助的可能性是早到组的六分之一。这些人在匆忙赶去布道时，只一心一意地想着完成任务，使他们对周围的其他事件视而不见。同样，这也是情境的力量。
p243.en: It is worth noting that the control of time constraints makes it possible for late persons to help one sixth of the group to arrive early. While rushing to preach, these people were only intent on fulfilling their mission and turned their eyes away from other events around them. Likewise, it is the force of the situation.

p244.original: 图11-6 “好撒玛利亚人”研究的结果
p244.en: Figure 11-6 Results of the study “Good Samaritan”

p245.original: 注：即使是在进行“好撒玛利亚人”布道的途中，绝大多数神学院的学生也没有停下来帮助陷入困境的遇险者。
p245.en: Note: Even on the way to the “good Samaritan” sermon, the vast majority of seminaries did not stop to help those in distress.

p246.original: 心理学很有用 穿上“耶鲁鞋”
p246.en: Psychology works. Put on Yale shoes.

p247.original: 在20世纪50年代中期，当菲利普·津巴多到达耶鲁大学开始研究生生活时，他身着南布朗克斯（South Bronx）的潮流穿搭——蓝色麂皮鞋、哈伦裤、长长的钥匙链、大翻领和其他酷帅的衣服。一两个月后，他穿着斜纹棉布裤子、纽扣衬衫和休闲鞋。他完全没有意识到令他改变服装“品位”的微妙的社会压力，但是他知道，那些古怪的耶鲁衣服比南布朗克斯的装扮更为合适。作为一名刚入行的心理学家，这一个人案例激发了他关于不成文的着装规范的研究。当时校园里的每个人都在遵循着这个规范，就好像海军陆战队教官正在命令我们无条件服从军令一样。
p247.en: In the mid-1950s, when Philip Zimbardo arrived at Yale University to start his graduate life, he was wearing the tide of the South Bronx — blue leather shoes, Haron pants, long key chains, big rolls and other cool clothes. One or two months later, he was wearing slashed cotton pants, button shirts and leisure shoes. He was completely unaware of the delicate social pressure to change his “grade” of clothing, but he knew that those weird Yale clothes were more suitable than those of the Southern Bronx. As a new psychologist, this individual case inspired his research on unwritten dress codes. Everyone on the campus was following that norm, as if the Marines instructors were ordering us to obey the order without conditions.

p248.original: 津巴多对高年级学生的采访表明，内群体（in-group）为了将自己与外群体（out-group）区别开，确实制定了一个强有力的着装规范。有识之士可以识别出哪一件衣服对于耶鲁男性是适宜穿着的（当时耶鲁大学都是男生）。他了解到“鞋子”的内涵（那个时代或更早的时候，耶鲁大学的男性可以通过穿着白色的皮鞋来分辨）。穿上这种鞋子就是在耶鲁大学的环境下进入潮流了、变得很酷、很时髦合群等。
p248.en: Interviews with senior students in Zimbabwe show that the inner-group does have a strong dress code to distinguish itself from the outside group (out-group). A man of knowledge can identify which dress is suitable for Yale males (when Yale University was both male). He learned about the meaning of “shoes” (in that age or earlier, men at Yale could be identified by wearing white shoes). It's like getting into the tide in Yale, getting cool and fashionable.

p249.original: 不仅是衣服，学校中的其他事物都可以显示你合群的程度。网球、高尔夫和赛艇都是潮流事物，而篮球不是。在课堂上提问并不是主流做法。足球比赛之前要举行车尾野餐，但前提是形式和风格要正确。让津巴多同样感兴趣的是，圈内潮流会定期变化，以防外人误入圈内。例如，前一年耶鲁大学大四学生带着戒指是入流的，今年可能就过时了。抑或手工领结将变得过时，而夹式领结将成为潮流。
p249.en: Not just clothes, but other things in school can show the extent of your grouping. Tennis, golf and boats are all currents, not basketball. Asking questions in the classroom is not the mainstream practice. The football match is preceded by a back-of-the-car picnic, provided that it is in the right form and style. Zimbabwe is also interested in the fact that the currents within the circle change regularly to prevent outsiders from entering the circle. For example, the four students of Yale University who had the ring in their hands the previous year were in circulation and may have become obsolete this year. Or the hand tie will become obsolete, while the tie will become the current.

p250.original: 他的信息提供者团队帮助他计算出了耶鲁大学学生当年穿着入流程度的指标。在学生的帮助下，他们走进了宿舍，看到每个班级的学生衣柜里到底有哪些服饰。然后，将每件服装与入流指数相乘，并计算大一到大四每个班级的平均评分。接下来，根据学生是来自私立学校还是公立中学，他们对学生的入流得分进行了区分。
p250.en: His team of information providers helped him to calculate indicators of the level of flow that Yale students were wearing that year. With the help of the students, they entered the dormitories and saw exactly what was in each class's closet. Each garment is then multiplied by the flow index and the average score is calculated for each class from the first to the fourth grade. Next, depending on whether the student is from a private school or a public secondary school, they make a distinction between the student's entry scores.

p251.original: 从耶鲁大学入流量化的图表中可以明显看出三个主要结果：
p251.en: Three main results can be seen in the flow of traffic at Yale University:

p252.original: 1. 随着学生年级的升高，他们的入流指数明显升高；
p252.en: 1. A significant increase in the flow index of students as they rise in grade;

p253.original: 2. 来自预科高中的学生的入流指数远远大于来自公立高中的学生；
p253.en: 2. The flow index for students from preparatory high schools is much greater than for students from public high schools;

p254.original: 3. 大学四年之后，预科生和公立生之间的差距缩小了，到高年级时，他们的入流程度几乎就没有差别了。
p254.en: 3. Four years later, the gap between pre-school and public students had narrowed, and their entry into the upper grades was virtually unchanged.

p255.original: 当耶鲁大学开始招收女生，这种“入流感”变得没有那么明显了，开始转入“地下”，现在可能只以其他形式存在。但是，无论你在哪所学校，都是如此：你的品位很多时候实际上是社会从众压力施加给你的，为了得到他人的喜欢，而迎合他人的品位。很多时候，我们为了与他人和睦相处也会如此（Zimbardo，2008）。
p255.en: When Yale University began to recruit girls, the “influenza” became less visible and began to “underground” and may now exist only in other forms. But wherever you are in school, it is true that many times your tastes are actually exerted by society from the pressure of the masses, and that they are adapted to the taste of others in order to get their taste. In many cases, we do so to live in harmony with others (Zimbardo, 2008).
